name: Imaad Davies
bio: As a vital member of the Alpha Crest Fund team since October 2023, Imaad leverages over four years of extensive fund management experience to drive the fund’s success. His multifaceted role encompasses rigorous research, strategic trading, robust risk management, and continuous refinement of the investment process.

Imaad’s strong analytical foundation, evidenced by his Master’s degrees in Chemical Engineering and his Financial Risk Manager (FRM) certification, underpins his contributions. Beyond his professional achievements, he maintains an active lifestyle through running and soccer, and cherishes time spent with his family.
